name: Arizona
overview: A refundable property-tax credit serves qualifying older residents and SSI recipients, including renters.

programs.name: Property Tax Refund (Credit)
programs.ageRule: Claimant or joint spouse age 65+; younger applicants qualify through SSI receipt.
programs.incomeDefinition: Household income; Social Security and railroad retirement are excluded.
programs.incomeLimits: Under $3,751 living alone; under $5,501 living with others.
programs.formulaSummary: Income-table credit limited by qualifying property taxes; renters use landlord-certified property taxes attributable to their unit.
programs.application: File 2025 Form 140PTC or attach it to an eligible Arizona income-tax return.
eligibilityNotes: Full-year Arizona residence and qualifying housing payments required.
Rent-only claimants generally must have rented throughout the year.
interactions: Deferred property taxes cannot support the same credit.
